flows.name: 日调度
flows.when: 每日 00:30 启动，处理 T-1（${bizdate}）数据

flows.name: 周调度
flows.when: 每周一 08:00，等待日调度周日分区质检通过后启动

flows.name: 月调度
flows.when: 每月 1 日 08:00，等待日调度上月末分区质检通过后启动

flows.name: 年调度
flows.when: 每年 12 月 1 日生成下一年日期维度（节假日公布后可手工重跑）

flows.name: 实时作业
flows.when: Flink 作业 7×24 运行，监控项每分钟采集

nodes.desc: 检查 18 个业务库 T-1 数据已完结：增量同步位点越过 ${bizdate_end}，源库主从延迟 < 60 秒

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd.dwd_fin_fund_flow_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 核心交易表空分区直接阻断下游；非交易表（投诉、审批等）允许当天无数据，只告警

rules.name: 主键/粒度键非空
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_cnt FROM dwd.dwd_fin_fund_flow_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND (flow_id IS NULL);

rules.name: flow_type 取值在枚举内
rules.desc: 取值清单来自字段注释；出现新值说明源系统新增了枚举，需同步码表与口径

rules.sql: SELECT flow_direction_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd.dwd_fin_fund_flow_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND flow_direction_type NOT IN (1, 2) GROUP BY flow_direction_type;

rules.name: 行数 与近 7 日均值相比波动 ≤ 50%
rules.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT travel_date, COUNT(*) AS v FROM dwd.dwd_fin_fund_flow_di
  WHERE travel_date BETWEEN '${bizdate_minus_7}' AND '${bizdate}' GROUP BY travel_date
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN travel_date = '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS cur,
       AVG(CASE WHEN travel_date < '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS avg7
FROM d;
rules.desc: 节假日首日、大促日会触发，告警人确认后放行

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 允许当天无业务发生，只告警

rules.name: 主键/粒度唯一（instance_id）
rules.desc: 重复会让下游汇总翻倍

rules.name: 主键/粒度键非空
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_cnt FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND (instance_id IS NULL);

rules.name: flow_id 能关联到 dim_opr_approval_flow_df
rules.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.approval_flow_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS miss_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di f
LEFT JOIN dim.dim_opr_approval_flow_df d ON f.flow_id = d.approval_flow_id AND d.travel_date = '${bizdate}'
WHERE f.travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND f.flow_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(f.flow_id AS STRING) NOT IN ('0', '');
rules.desc: 关联不上会在报表里落成“未知”；常见原因是维表晚到或源端脏数据

rules.name: instance_status 取值在枚举内
rules.desc: 取值清单来自字段注释；出现新值说明源系统新增了枚举，需同步码表与口径

rules.name: timeout_type 取值在枚举内
rules.sql: SELECT timeout_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND timeout_type NOT IN (0, 1) GROUP BY timeout_type;

rules.name: 金额/数量非负（2 个字段）
rules.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN approval_minute_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approval_minute_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN approval_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approval_qty_neg
FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 变动额、利润、净额类字段允许为负，已排除

rules.name: 行数 与近 7 日均值相比波动 ≤ 50%
rules.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT travel_date, COUNT(*) AS v FROM dwd.dwd_opr_approval_di
  WHERE travel_date BETWEEN '${bizdate_minus_7}' AND '${bizdate}' GROUP BY travel_date
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN travel_date = '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS cur,
       AVG(CASE WHEN travel_date < '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS avg7
FROM d;
rules.desc: 节假日首日、大促日会触发，告警人确认后放行

rules.name: 金额/数量非负（17 个字段）
rules.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_group_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_group_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_ticket_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_ticket_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_ticket_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_ticket_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_buyer_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_buyer_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cancel_order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cancel_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN staff_order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN combo_order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS combo_order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_order_group_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_order_group_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cost_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_minute_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_minute_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN timeout_cancel_order_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_cancel_order_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN advance_book_day_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS advance_book_day_qty_neg
FROM dws.dws_ord_tenant_sku_channel_trade_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 变动额、利润、净额类字段允许为负，已排除

rules.name: order_group_qty 与近 7 日均值相比波动 ≤ 50%
rules.sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT travel_date, SUM(order_group_qty) AS v FROM dws.dws_ord_tenant_sku_channel_trade_di
  WHERE travel_date BETWEEN '${bizdate_minus_7}' AND '${bizdate}' GROUP BY travel_date
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN travel_date = '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS cur,
       AVG(CASE WHEN travel_date < '${bizdate}' THEN v END) AS avg7
FROM d;
rules.desc: 节假日首日、大促日会触发，告警人确认后放行

rules.name: 对账：order_ticket_qty 与 dwd_ord_order_di.buy_ticket_qty 合计一致
rules.sql:
SELECT (SELECT SUM(order_ticket_qty) FROM dws.dws_ord_tenant_sku_channel_trade_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}') AS dws_v,
       (SELECT SUM(buy_ticket_qty) FROM dwd.dwd_ord_order_di WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}') AS dwd_v;
rules.desc: 汇总层不丢不重

rules.sql:

rules.name: 勾稽：discount_rate = avg_deal_price_amt × 100 / list_price_amt

  AND ABS(discount_rate - ROUND(avg_deal_price_amt * 100 / list_price_amt, 6)) > 0.000001;
rules.desc: 分母为 0 时比率应为 NULL

nodes.cn: 商户经营周报 质检

rules.name: 当日分区有数据
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_wk WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 核心交易表空分区直接阻断下游；非交易表（投诉、审批等）允许当天无数据，只告警

rules.name: 主键/粒度唯一（stat_week_code + week_start_date + seller_tenant_id）
rules.desc: 重复会让下游汇总翻倍

rules.name: 主键/粒度键非空
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_wk WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND (stat_week_code IS NULL OR week_start_date IS NULL OR seller_tenant_id IS NULL);

rules.name: 金额/数量非负（4 个字段）
rules.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_1w_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_1w_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN verify_ticket_1w_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verify_ticket_1w_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN refund_1w_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_1w_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN per_customer_1w_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS per_customer_1w_amt_neg
FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_wk WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 变动额、利润、净额类字段允许为负，已排除

rules.name: 比率值域（1 个字段）
rules.desc: 比率存百分数数值；占比、售罄、在线类不超过 100，转化/退款类因跨期可能超过 100，只校验非负；环比、毛利率不校验

rules.name: 勾稽：net_pay_1w_amt = pay_1w_amt − refund_1w_amt
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_wk WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND ABS(COALESCE(net_pay_1w_amt, 0) - (COALESCE(pay_1w_amt, 0) - COALESCE(refund_1w_amt, 0))) > 0.01;
rules.desc: 同一行内的计算关系必须成立

rules.name: 当日分区有数据
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ads.ads_opr_package_revenue_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 允许当天无业务发生，只告警

rules.name: 主键/粒度唯一（stat_month_code + package_id）
rules.desc: 重复会让下游汇总翻倍

rules.name: 主键/粒度键非空
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_cnt FROM ads.ads_opr_package_revenue_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND (stat_month_code IS NULL OR package_id IS NULL);

rules.name: 金额/数量非负（5 个字段）
rules.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN package_1m_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS package_1m_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN package_renew_1m_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS package_renew_1m_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN active_subscription_1m_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_subscription_1m_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN expiring_30d_subscription_1m_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_30d_subscription_1m_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN package_ytd_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS package_ytd_amt_neg
FROM ads.ads_opr_package_revenue_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 变动额、利润、净额类字段允许为负，已排除

rules.name: 比率值域（1 个字段）
rules.desc: 比率存百分数数值；占比、售罄、在线类不超过 100，转化/退款类因跨期可能超过 100，只校验非负；环比、毛利率不校验

nodes.cn: 商户经营月报 质检

rules.name: 当日分区有数据
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 核心交易表空分区直接阻断下游；非交易表（投诉、审批等）允许当天无数据，只告警

rules.name: 主键/粒度唯一（stat_month_code + seller_tenant_id）
rules.desc: 重复会让下游汇总翻倍

rules.name: 主键/粒度键非空
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND (stat_month_code IS NULL OR seller_tenant_id IS NULL);

rules.name: 金额/数量非负（4 个字段）
rules.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN pay_1m_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pay_1m_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN verify_ticket_1m_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verify_ticket_1m_qty_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN refund_1m_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_1m_amt_neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN per_customer_1m_amt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS per_customer_1m_amt_neg
FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}';
rules.desc: 变动额、利润、净额类字段允许为负，已排除

rules.name: 比率值域（1 个字段）
rules.desc: 比率存百分数数值；占比、售罄、在线类不超过 100，转化/退款类因跨期可能超过 100，只校验非负；环比、毛利率不校验

rules.name: 勾稽：net_pay_1m_amt = pay_1m_amt − refund_1m_amt
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_cnt FROM ads.ads_sup_tenant_trade_mo WHERE travel_date = '${bizdate}' AND ABS(COALESCE(net_pay_1m_amt, 0) - (COALESCE(pay_1m_amt, 0) - COALESCE(refund_1m_amt, 0))) > 0.01;
rules.desc: 同一行内的计算关系必须成立

nodes.desc: 写就绪标记（_SUCCESS / 元数据就绪表），触发报表缓存刷新与下游订阅；任一强校验失败则不发布并电话告警
依赖日调度中以下质检节点在最近一次通过：无
